key_insight: An exact sparse auxiliary representation makes Carleman embeddings practical for quantum state preparation, with truncation error decreasing geometrically and uniformly over all iterations under stated assumptions.
engineering_relevance: For qualifying nonlinear discrete models, the approach supports quantum preparation of a normalized iterate with query complexity linear in iteration count and polylogarithmic in inverse accuracy.
method: Embed forced quadratic dynamics into a truncated linear system using tensor powers.
Apply coefficient maps one tensor factor at a time, keeping row and column sparsities bounded independently of truncation degree.
Rescale the history system to obtain condition-number growth linear in iteration count, then prepare the normalized final iterate.
evidence_signal: The paper proves error, sparsity, conditioning, and query-complexity bounds; numerical experiments in one and three dimensions illustrate truncation convergence.
watch_item: The guarantees require explicit stability and initial-state assumptions, coherent input access, fixed sparsity parameters, and a known positive lower bound on the final-state norm.
paper_title: Sparse Carleman Embeddings for Nonlinear Discrete Dynamical Systems
